resources.string: The shortcut option shown by Android should not be enabled; it is not needed. This service detects which apps are visible on screen so Take a Break can block apps that are PIN-locked or over their daily limit. Only app package names are used; screen content is not read or stored.

This app is screen-pinned, so Home and Recents are disabled. To leave it: hold Back + Overview (3-button navigation) or swipe up and hold (gesture navigation), then go Home. Android may ask for your fingerprint or PIN when you unpin; that is normal. The PIN pad below still works.
